---
name: Feature / new tool request
about: Suggest a new tool or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What tool or feature would you like?**
A clear description. Link to an existing similar tool elsewhere if helpful.

**Can this run entirely client-side (in the browser, no server)?**
This project only accepts tools that don't require uploading files to a server. If you're not
sure, describe how you think it could work client-side, or flag that it might need a server (in
which case it's likely v2/out of scope — see README).

**Why is this useful?**
Who needs this and what's the use case?
